envelope.description: Scratch panels controller + browse-all table view (insrc.scratchpads)

body.title: Scratch panels controller + browse-all table view (insrc.scratchpads)
body.summary: NEW vscode-free scratch-panels controller (panels/scratch-panels.ts): wraps the injected PanelFactory with per-viewType create-or-reveal singletons + injected setTitle, and implements the insrc.scratchpads browse-all tabular editor-pane view (Name/Modified columns, icon-only Open/Delete rows with title hover text + data-id, empty/error rows, unbounded list data). Plus the browse-table half of scratch-panel.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts is a NEW vscode-free controller wrapping the injected PanelFactory (extension.ts:447) with its own create-or-reveal singleton cache per viewType (mirroring openSingleton webview-host.ts:214); onDidDispose clears the cached handle

handle exposes setHtml/reveal/setTitle/onDidDispose/onMessage/postMessage/dispose — setTitle is an injected op with a production adapter to the underlying WebviewPanel title; stock PanelHandle (panels/types.ts:134-135) has none

insrc.scratchpads browse view renders a tabular editor pane: Name + Modified columns, per-row icon-only Open/Delete buttons with title hover text and data-id posting scratch-open {id}/scratch-delete {id}, empty hint row, error row; table data comes from an UNBOUNDED listScratches() (no limit) fetched by the host, never the capped menu list
panel creation failure returns undefined + panelLog warning (never throws) and next click retries
scratch-panel.test.ts (new) covers browse table, row buttons, empty/error states, create-or-reveal reuse of a single panel instance

tests.name: scratch-panel.test.ts: browse viewType insrc.scratchpads renders a table with Name and Modified columns (ac3)
scratch-panel.test.ts: each row has icon-only Open/Delete buttons (title hover text, data-id) posting scratch-open/scratch-delete (ac3, ac5)
scratch-panel.test.ts: empty list renders a hint row; create-or-reveal reuses a single panel instance; panel-factory failure returns undefined + logged and next click retries (ac3)
